leadText:
Bailey (Japanese: ヒカル Hikaru) is a character of the day who appeared in Flower Power. She travels around in her van, where she to dance and perform various acrobatic moves to put on shows, similar to a Pokémon Coordinator.

 and met Bailey at the Florando Pokémon Exhibition. She later helped teach several dance-like dodging techniques to assist in his upcoming s. One of her lacked the confidence to do a complex flip move until a fight with inspired it to finally execute it perfectly.
